data.gender_notes: Sahajamal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sahajamal is a name derived from Sanskrit and Hindi origin. It is a compound name, composed of two words: Sahaja (born with) and Mala (garland of blessings). This name signifies that the child was born with blessings from the gods and the universe. The name Sahajamal carries the meaning “Born with blessings” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sahajamal usually hope their child will grow to embody born with blessings and live with faith, good character and purpose.

They are said to have a strong connection with the divine and are often seen as spiritual leaders or guides.
